post_title: PTC70 - Controlled Thaw Cabinet (70kg) | Precision-UK
post_content: British refrigeration manufacturer Precision launched a cabinet designed to safely thaw frozen food, and store it chilled once it is defrosted. The controlled thaw reach-in cabinet, model PTC70, can defrost up to 70kg of food at a time. When frozen food is loaded into the PTC70, heaters turn on to bring it up to temperature under controlled conditions. The cabinet constantly monitors the air temperature and, once the food is defrosted, switches to standard chilled storage automatically. Typically a thaw cycle, from -18°C to 1°C, takes about six hours and most caterers will run the cycle overnight. When the cabinet is in chilled storage mode, the defrosted food can be safely left until it is needed.
